bug_semantics: In packet-rate mode, tcpreplay parses --pps as a double, rejects only an exactly zero double, then converts the value to integer packets per hour with (COUNTER)(n * 60.0 * 60.0). The published local input -0.000001 is nonzero before conversion but becomes integer zero after -0.0036 is truncated. calc_sleep_time subsequently divides its next-transmit-time numerator by that zero pph value, causing SIGFPE and terminating the replay process.
flaw_origin: The original PR-member commit fb5c9c21064e799c8b77c61e282d39ea853e77b9 first changed --pps from AutoOpts numeric input to an unrestricted string parsed by atof, stored the unchecked scaled result in COUNTER, and changed the packet-rate calculation to divide by packets per hour. Its direct parent lacks that coupled input/conversion/division path. GitHub squash-landed the member as the distinct commit object 175f7ed06c6ad6488020220f9917ca213c568251, which has the same parent and tree; because the original one-commit PR member is available and reconstructable, the landing object is not the attribution BIC. The later exact-zero check in ebed7dde22ef3b77ceb64eefa2c873b92b435dda does not reject a nonzero fraction that truncates to zero after scaling.

reasoning: The only blind-audit disagreement was introducer_sha. Content equivalence alone does not make the two commit objects interchangeable under the protocol: the BIC must be the smallest real commit that first wrote the vulnerable lines, and a reconstructable PR member takes precedence over its GitHub squash landing. The PR API identifies fb5c9c21064e799c8b77c61e282d39ea853e77b9 as the sole original member and 175f7ed06c6ad6488020220f9917ca213c568251 as the merge commit; raw objects prove that GitHub recreated the same tree over the same parent with different committer/message metadata. The parent diff proves the vulnerable fractional-string parse, unchecked scaled integer conversion, and zero-divisor sink first appear together in the member, with no rename/import ambiguity. Therefore the primary's introducer claim wins and the reviewer's landing-object claim is rejected; squash_decomposed is true with the one member as both decomposed SHA and BIC. The landed identical tree is present in affected releases, and no later reachable change removes or validates the post-conversion zero value. Because the case is explicitly unpatched, null fix fields satisfy the closure exception. Finally, the adjudicated member's own commit object has no AI marker, yielding NOT_AI.
